description: This file defines a 'Loader' component using LightningJS framework, which displays animated circles as a loading indicator. It includes component registration, template, props, state, lifecycle hook, and method for toggling animation.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a loading spinner with animated circles.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates an interval that toggles the alpha property to animate fade-in and fade-out of loader circles.
